subject: Clearmap — Q2 commit: deal risk triage and contingency checklist
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Andrew Mills <andrew.mills@clearmap.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearmap — Q2 commit: deal risk triage and contingency checklist

Team —

Quick triage this morning on the Clearmap commit. Finance flagged the projected Q2 ARR in HubSpot as at-risk (we're showing a 45% probability today). We need a short runbook and owner-level updates by EOD so FP&A can finalize the forecast.

Asks (short):
- Marissa: confirm customer readiness (PO, procurement timeline, signatures).
- Ben: list outstanding technical blockers that would push the start date beyond the quarter.
- Laura: proposed credit/discount options if revenue recognition slips past the cut.

I attached a simple matrix to capture red/yellow/green status by line item — please update the matrix inline and reply. We'll consolidate and send this to Clearmap with a single ask: commit confirmation or signed SOW by Friday COB.

Attached: Q2_commit_matrix.xlsx

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
SVP, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Andrew Mills <andrew.mills@clearmap.ai>, procurement@clearmap.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearmap — Q2 commit: deal risk triage and contingency checklist

Sean —

I've run through their responses from last week and updated the attached matrix with status per line (row-level notes). TL;DR:
- License: YELLOW — legal has one redline on the SOW (sales and legal are synced).
- Professional services: GREEN — PS scheduling confirmed for June start, not blocking Q2 revenue if license signs this week.
- Integrations: RED — one dependency on Clearmap's data team to provide schema; without it we can't onboard in time.

I've put recommended owner and a single contingency for each red/yellow item (discount band, uplift in services, or deferred milestone). Ben — can you confirm the technical item ETA if we escalate?

Attached: Q2_commit_matrix.xlsx, SOW_Attachment_v2.pdf

Marissa Cole
Deal Lead | North America Sales
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Sean —

Confirming technical impact: the integration schema is the blocker. If we can get schema by EOD Wed (5/13) our onboarding timeline holds and we can still recognize revenue in Q2. If we don't get schema until next Monday, onboarding and validation push into late June — that creates a revenue recognition risk for Q2.

Mitigation options:
- Escalate Clearmap's engineering lead to prioritize (preferred).
- Ship a temporary connector with limited fields (would require an engineering sprint, estimated 8 engineer-days).

I recommend we escalate now and offer a 2-week onboarding buffer in the SOW if they need more time (keeps them engaged without immediate discounting).

Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick answers from our side:
- Procurement: targeting a signed SOW by Thursday noon after final legal redline review.
